architecture_binding: F2-WP-1201 generation-1 TargetHostProfile + Host Reality Twin / UnifiedDB completion epistemics
summary: WP1201 generation 1 is a useful privacy-bounded, deterministic, UNKNOWN-preserving whole-snapshot collector and its repository-CI evidence remains valid at that scope. Trigger-6 source audit and direct source mapping show that one global profile digest currently mixes stable platform facts with volatile session/device/software/runtime facts and lacks separate stable pseudonymous host and boot scopes. Before first physical target-profile admission, a successor should preserve the whole snapshot digest for provenance but add HostScopeIdentity, BootScopeIdentity, independently digested profile components/runtime witnesses, and requirement-specific binding digests so irrelevant changes do not stale unrelated evidence while relevant changes still fail closed.
privacy_finding: Do not add raw /etc/machine-id. systemd explicitly treats it as confidential; if stable local host lineage is needed, use an application-specific irreversible derived identity. Keep transient application/media stream descriptions out of stable host fingerprint material unless an explicit requirement needs them.
counterhypothesis: The monolithic digest is maximally conservative and simpler. If physical revalidation is cheap and host snapshots are infrequent, its broad invalidation may be preferable. Trigger-4 should adopt component/requirement binding only after a deterministic false-staleness ablation proves benefit without weakening rejection of relevant changes.
next_exact_gate: Trigger-4 successor/repair lane should first run a no-physical-host deterministic ablation over existing WP1201 snapshots: audio-stream-only change, browser-only change, USB change, reboot, kernel/driver change, permission loss and synthetic platform change. Compare global-digest invalidation with requirement-scoped component binding. Promote only if irrelevant-change invalidation falls while all requirement-relevant stale-evidence cases remain rejected. Then use the first real read-only target bundle to bind exact HostScope/Boot/Profile identities without granting whole-host completion from collection alone.
